text_block_list.text:
The Holy Hoof Festival is a huge hit again 
this year. As I'm happily strolling around 
the academy—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah-hah-hah-hah-hah!!!! I see, so you are 
the executor of my vengeance!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
O you who know not fear, are you prepared 
to defy the ruler!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Takes two to tango. You can't dance the 
tango alone, after all. —Just the way I 
like it!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
…………Tch, both sound like a pain in the 
ass…….

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I came here with Tap to promote the 
stage play, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Gather, my disciples! I shall show you new 
chaos upon the beautiful Twilight of the 
Gods!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Curtain rises—in the afternoon. The 
theme is—rebellion, resistance against the 
system—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Shakur!! Have you heard about Gimlet and 
the others' play?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. Looks like the contents overlap.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that... looks like the other 
side is winning in terms of social media 
virality.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I guess that makes us rogues chasing the 
same treasure. Then I can't afford to fall 
behind...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Gimlet! Looks like you guys are gonna 
be our rivals for today's performance!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —And so, things got troublesome.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—We're telling the same story. In that 
case, why don't we see who can draw a 
bigger crowd to prove whose stage is 
purer?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Challenging us to a match shows 
quite a lack of fear on your part. Do you 
truly intend to surpass this towering 
wall?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Easily! I don't feel like losing at all. 
After all, my crew is the absolute best, 
especially my right hand!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"What my hands hold is the finest sea 
route plotted by the finest first mate. If 
I lost with that, it'd tarnish my name as 
captain, wouldn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...... Tch, you really leave me no 
choice...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
For now, I tossed some bait onto social 
media to stir up conflict with Gimlet and 
the others.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now, even if we leave it alone, the folks 
looking for a laugh will spread it all on 
their own.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Daring to whip up a fierce gale and make 
some waves, huh? Interesting! That'll take 
us in a straight line straight to the 
treasure!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Once the info gets out, the attention will 
be split down the middle. After that, if 
we can build a lead through good old 
footwork and promo, we're golden, but—
choice_data_list: I'll help hand out flyers, too!
I'll help hand out flyers, too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Great! Gimlet and the others are tough 
opponents... But let's fight tooth and 
nail until the very end!

And so, we continued our promotional 
efforts right up until the show was about 
to start—
(WAAAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Gathered Spectators
text_block_list.text:
You're the greatest, Tap Dance City! 
Tap~~, that was so cool~~!! I'm so 
moved~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"—There you are, my beloved rivals! Come, 
the battle is over. Let us fill our 
goblets with the mead of Heiðrún!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――This is... your victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yet—our morale also rose, and we were 
able—to contribute—to the success of the 
Holy Hoof Festival.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We're comrades who competed and 
claimed the same treasure! Let's celebrate 
our success! Dance the night away!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, hey, Shakur! You come along too, 
it's a celebration banquet!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Idiot. Do whatever you want.

Though Air Shakur scoffed, he looked 
somehow satisfied deep down. And thus, the 
Holy Hoof Festival concluded with great 
success.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
For now, I tossed some bait onto social 
media to stir up conflict with Gimlet and 
the others.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now, even if we leave it alone, the folks 
looking for a laugh will spread it all on 
their own.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Daring to whip up a fierce gale and make 
some waves, huh? Interesting! That'll take 
us in a straight line straight to the 
treasure!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Once the info gets out, the attention will 
be split down the middle. After that, if 
we can build a lead through good old 
footwork and promo, we're golden, but—

I'll help hand out flyers, too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Great! Gimlet and the others are tough 
opponents... But let's fight tooth and 
nail until the very end!

And so, we continued our promotional 
efforts right up until the afternoon 
performance began—
(WOOOOO----!!)

text_block_list.name: Gathered Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Lord Gim~~~!!! Kris S, you were amazing 
too--!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—I lost. It's frustrating, but it was a 
fantastic stage!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It won't go like this next time. I swear I 
will take back the treasure I entrusted to 
you!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Very well. Let us look 
forward to the day the horn resounds!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—The success of the Holy Hoof Festival is 
a great achievement. I am grateful... that 
we could compete together.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Exaggerating. Well, I'm just relieved we 
made it through with no issues.

Though they lost the crowd-drawing 
contest, their bond seems to have 
deepened. And thus, the Holy Hoof Festival 
came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey. You don't need to go out of your way 
to compete with each other.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We both share the same goal: to draw in a 
huge crowd.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Then what we need is cooperation, not 
conflict. Don't lose sight of the 
objective.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... True, as long as I can have fun 
with my crew, that's all that matters to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Our—Mission— The requirement is—the same. 
...Not victory—success.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah, then this makes things simple. I'm 
gonna need you to lend a hand too, got it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"If we team up to promote it, we can 
expect a pretty significant boost in 
drawing a crowd, right?"

Settling matters smoothly, and even 
gaining a collaborator in the process. I 
was deeply impressed by Air Shakur's 
efficiency.
